meta.purpose: Every item that could not be confirmed from a primary source, every contradiction found while verifying, and every decision that is blocked on missing information. Nothing in this file is a blocker to publishing the site; it is the review queue.
meta.convention: A flag has an ID, a severity, what was expected, what was observed, and what would close it. If a flag can be closed by checking an official page, the link to that page is included.

flags.title: Associates enrollment for tag shopnow047c-20 is unconfirmed
flags.expected: An approved Associates account whose storefront ID is shopnow047c-20.
flags.observed: The tag was supplied in the build brief. Nothing in this environment can confirm that the account exists, is approved, or owns this tag.
flags.whyItMatters: Links carrying a tag that is not enrolled earn nothing, and a Site that displays Associates links without an approved account is outside the program (S02 Participation Requirements 1).
flags.howToClose: Sign in to Associates Central, open Account Settings, and confirm the storefront ID reads shopnow047c-20.

flags.title: Sales-activity requirement for continued enrollment not checked against the account
flags.expected: Associates must refer a threshold of sales to remain in the program.
flags.observed: The applicable threshold is set out in the Participation Requirements. This build confirmed the clause exists and links to it, but did not quote a number, because the number is stated in a section that was inspected for other purposes and should be re-read in place before it is relied on.
flags.howToClose: Read Participation Requirements section 5 in full at the linked page and record the current threshold verbatim.
flags.blocks: Nothing on the site; affects campaign planning only

flags.title: None of the five supplied short links carried a visible Associates tag, and none resolved to the ASIN its code appears to spell
flags.expected: A Special Link carries the Associates tag as a URL parameter (S02 Participation Requirements 2(b), S01 Section 1).
flags.observed: For all five supplied links the resolved URL carried page-context parameters only, with no tag parameter. In all five cases the supplied code and the resolved ASIN differ, for example B04G1MEwY resolved to B0CDY277D3.
flags.whyItMatters: If untagged, clicks cannot be attributed and no commission accrues. Separately, a code that looks like an ASIN but resolves elsewhere is exactly the failure mode a product-intent record is meant to catch.
flags.notClaimed: This file does not assert that the links are invalid or that using them breaches the Operating Agreement. Their compliance status is unresolved. The observation is limited to what the redirect did on 2026-11-20.
flags.howToClose: Run the enrollment test in link-audit.json: generate one SiteStripe link, publish it, click it once, and confirm the click in the tracking report before scaling to the other four.
flags.blocks: Scaling from one test link to five live links

flags.title: No price or star rating is published anywhere on this site
flags.expected: Prices and ratings are useful to a buyer.
flags.observed: The retrieved product pages mix the viewed product's price with prices for recommended products in the same text, so a single figure could not be attributed with confidence. Separately, S02 Participation Requirements 2(b) permits showing price and availability only when Amazon serves the data or it arrives via Creators API / PA API with a date stamp and the required disclaimer.
flags.whyItMatters: Publishing a price copied from a static page is both unreliable and outside the permitted methods. Publishing a rating that belongs to a different product would be the exact misleading-claim failure S02 prohibits.
flags.howToClose: Either enable SiteStripe-served pricing widgets, or obtain Creators API access, then publish price with the timestamp and the required disclaimer text.
flags.blocks: Price comparison features; does not block the shop

flags.title: Manufacturer certifications cited in two listings were not checked against the certifying bodies
flags.expected: A listing's NIST/NSF and accuracy claims can be checked against a public certification registry.
flags.observed: The ThermoMaven listing claims ±0.5°F accuracy and NIST and NSF certification. The CHEF iQ listing claims 1000°F heat safety. These are reproduced on the site only as seller claims, never as tested facts, because the certifying bodies' registries were not consulted.
flags.whyItMatters: S05 says you cannot make up claims about a product that would require proof. Repeating a seller's certification claim as if it were independently verified is the same error with an extra step.
flags.howToClose: Look up the model in the NSF product listing database and in NIST's calibration program records; record the certificate or the absence of one.
flags.blocks: Any page that would rank these two products on accuracy

flags.title: No product in this set has been physically handled by the publisher
flags.expected: First-hand testing before a recommendation is framed as experience.
flags.observed: Nothing in this environment can operate an air fryer. All strengths on the site are labelled as listing claims and all trade-offs are labelled as editorial inference from the listing, not as measurements.
flags.whyItMatters: S05 is explicit that you cannot talk about your experience with a product you have not tried. The site therefore never describes first-hand use of any product.
flags.howToClose: Buy or borrow one unit, run a documented protocol, and publish the protocol and results. Until then the labels stay.
flags.blocks: First-person review content; does not block listing-based guides

flags.title: Product summaries were read from one rendering of each page on one date
flags.observed: Amazon listings vary by variant, by session and over time. Each product row records observedOn: 2026-11-20 and should be re-checked before it is relied on commercially.
flags.howToClose: Re-run the observed-field check monthly and update observedOn, or replace the static rows with API-served data.

flags.title: The repo contained no application code to review
flags.observed: The repository held one commit (5f65079) containing a README.md of six bytes with no trailing newline and no other files. There was no code, no configuration, no data, and no site. Nothing was deleted.
flags.howToClose: Closed by this build, which adds the site and its data. Recorded so the review has a starting point.

flags.title: GitHub Actions is disabled on this repository, so the link resolver workflow cannot run
flags.expected: A workflow that resolves the supplied links and prints the redirect chain on a GitHub runner.
flags.observed: gh workflow run returned HTTP 404 and the Actions permissions endpoint returned 403 for this integration. The workflow file is present but inert. Link resolution was therefore done by direct fetch instead.
flags.howToClose: Enable Actions in repository settings, or delete the unused workflow file.

flags.title: Nothing in this project can measure whether a link converts yet
flags.expected: Click and conversion measurement before content investment.
flags.observed: The site ships an outbound-click counter that runs in the visitor's browser and posts a single event with no cookie and no identifier. Conversion data lives only in Associates reports, which require the owner's sign-in. No conversion figure is estimated or forecast anywhere on this site.
flags.howToClose: Deploy the collection endpoint described in the analytics contract, then reconcile click counts against Associates reports monthly.
flags.blocks: Any claim about performance or revenue
